question: What emerges and is worshiped from her crest?
premises: At her crest-tip is indeed the one-syllabled.
Her limbs and so on are thus.
Then the universe emerged and is worshiped in south and north.
inference: From her crest the one-syllabled and her limbs are set, then the universe emerges and is worshiped in both directions.
uncertainties: The fused tvaikārṇāṃ and tasyāścāṅgādikaṃ are compressed.
plain_english: At her crest-tip is indeed the one-syllabled; her limbs and so on are thus; then the universe emerged and is worshiped in south and north.
